articles.title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
articles.snippet: The Democratic ranking member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations asked Paolo Ardoino for records related to a reported deal between Tether and Nxum.

articles.title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
articles.snippet: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.
